limitations: The theorem classifies the specific consecutive derivative ratios only. Classical Eulerian-root and Laplace-transform facts are not new. Equivalent prior coverage under different polylogarithm or Eulerian notation cannot be excluded. Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Independent audit has not been performed.
provenance: Resolution of Wei and Guo (2014), Conjecture 12, by rewriting negative-integer polylogarithm ratios with Eulerian polynomials and applying right-half-plane holomorphy of Laplace transforms.
record_title: Complete-monotonicity classification for consecutive exponential-derivative ratios
